title: Ochre paint workshop
place: Blombos Cave, Western Cape, South Africa
summary: Abalone shells used as containers for mixing ochre paint form a 100,000-year-old toolkit.
why: Early evidence of paint making: chemistry, planning and color, all in one kit.

notes.problem: 'Earliest known paint making' is not in the source, which says only 'ochre processing workshop' in 100,000-year-old levels.
